verdict.rationale: Docs confirm segments and tags exist as addressable objects (used via ids to target broadcasts) and mention bulk subscriber creation and audience tagging/segmentation as a feature, implying some programmatic tag/segment handling, but no evidence pack item shows explicit create/update endpoints for segments/tags/lists or an endpoint to read back the exact subscriber membership of a segment or tag. missing for 10: explicit API reference for creating/updating segments or tags, an endpoint to list/read subscribers belonging to a given segment/tag/list, and any independent confirmation of this working end-to-end.
